items.label: Convenient and Roomy
items.value: Available in two compact sizes, 11.02" x 3.35" x 7.48" and 8.5" x 2.56" x 3.54", this cosmetic bag can hold all your makeup and skincare items based on their size. Slightly larger than the palm of your hand, it is easy to carry while ensuring durability and portability—making it not only a great travel gift for women but also perfect stocking stuffers for teen girls

items.label: Multiple Uses
items.value: As a makeup bag, you can sort and tidy cosmetics. As a travel toiletries bag, you can separate toiletries from skin care products and cosmetics to keep them clean. The small bags can even be used as a daughter's pencil case or period bag, which is really the first choice for gifts

items.label: Vibrant Color Options
items.value: Choose from a range of colors including pink, blue, purple, yellow, white,and black, each featuring all 26 letters of the alphabet. Tailor your bag to your personal style and preference. Personalized gifts for women

items.label: Personalized Gift Choice
items.value: Ideal for any woman, this cosmetic bags is perfect for bridesmaid, daughters, granddaughters, mothers, wife, friends, and teachers. A thoughtful gift for all ages, for mothers days, birthdays, valentines day or any special occasion.

items.label: Our Guarantee
items.value: A 1-Year Warranty for your makeup bag, backed by our commitment to resolve any issues swiftly, ensuring your satisfaction and peace of mind.In addition, we suggest hand-wash to keep durable
